description: TPS Eastern Africa Limited is a Kenya-based company, which owns and operates hotel and lodge facilities in Eastern Africa, serving the business and tourist markets. The Company, along with its subsidiaries, is principally engaged in owning and operating 32 resorts, safari lodges and hotels, which are located in East Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, Uganda and Mozambique) and Southern Asia (Pakistan, Afghanistan and Tajikistan). Its segments include Kenya Hotels, Kenya Lodges and Tanzania Lodges. The Company operates through several subsidiaries, including Tourism Promotion Services (Kenya) Limited, Tourism Promotion Services (Tanzania) Limited & Tourism Promotion Services (Zanzibar) Limited.
